messages.content: Search only the three FACT TEXTS for explicit factual assertions using the supplied ordinary cache input interface. Questions, requested answers, source rule bodies and cached target labels are deliberately absent. This foundational input-concept scope is the same one used by the original relation reader; the predicate names and ordered roles here are the newly acquired cache API. Return only those supplied predicates. Do not derive legal consequences or emit section_*_applies, deduction amounts or target assertions. A statement that someone satisfies section152(c)(1) is an expressly given qualifying-child status for the named claimant; it is not by itself an asserted dependent status after other exceptions. Emit dependent only when the FACT TEXT explicitly calls that individual the claimant's dependent. An explicit entitlement to an exemption for another individual under151 is the supplied allowance-status input, not an assertion that151(d)(2) or151(d)(5) applies. Respect the actual role order: child/relative/subject first, claimant second for this cache. Do not copy the order of a different API. case_subject_year enumerates every person and explicit annual year in the facts. Distinct-identifier and annual-calendar-year metadata are supplied by the common deterministic task adapter, so do not invent separate predicates. No missing status is false. The2018-through2025 input requires explicit period-classification evidence; do not invent it from an ordinary year mention. Each substantive fact quote must be a nonempty exact substring of its own fact text. No extra predicates, tools, browsing, inference or final answers.

Bob counts as Alice's dependent under section 152(c)(1) for 2015."}, {"ordinal": 86, "facts": "Alice has a son, Bob, who satisfies section 152(c)(1) for the year 2015. Bob has a son, Charlie, who satisfies section 152(c)(1) for the year 2015."}, {"ordinal": 72, "facts": "Alice is entitled to an exemption under section 151(d) for Bob for the year 2015."}], "expected_ordinals": [81, 86, 72]}
